title: Cover Fly
description: Twelve Beatles records and an Up next tray. Tap a cover and a copy lifts off it and arcs into the queue while the record gets a numbered badge; tap it in the tray, on its cover, or mid-air and it flies home and the slot closes.
intent: One flight finished to the edge: a cover thrown from the grid into a queue on a live-tracked arc, reversible mid-flight, with the source left intact and marked rather than emptied.
